# quoteai

> quoteai (quoteai.ca) is quoting and job-management software for Canadian trade contractors and small service businesses. A contractor describes a job in plain words, by text or voice, and quoteai drafts a professional quote in about 30 seconds: line items, quantities, unit prices and the correct Canadian sales tax for the customer's province. The same numbers then flow into the contract, e-signature, deposit, job, invoice and payment. It works in English and French (Canada), on the web and as an Android app.

Key facts:
- Who it is for: independent tradespeople and small contracting firms in Canada (painters, electricians, plumbers, roofers, HVAC technicians, general contractors, landscapers, cleaners and more).
- Market: Canada only. Launching first in British Columbia, Ontario and Québec (the pilot provinces).
- Languages: English (en-CA) and French (fr-CA); quotes can be written in either language for the customer.
- Taxes: GST, HST, PST and QST are shown as separate lines, as the CRA and provincial ministries expect, never one blended rate.
- Payments: customers pay by Interac e-Transfer, cheque or card; card payments go to the contractor's own Stripe account.
- Trial: 7 days free, no credit card. A single quote can also be bought without a plan.
- Prices are in Canadian dollars, before tax.
- Company: quoteai, Canada. Contact: info@quoteai.ca.

## Plans

- Starter: CA$29/month, 15 AI quotes a month
- Pro: CA$79/month, 60 AI quotes a month
- Business: CA$249/month, unlimited quotes
- Elite: custom price

Annual billing charges ten months for a year. Details: [Pricing](https://quoteai.ca/pricing/).

## Features

- [Estimating software for contractors, with Canadian sales tax built in](https://quoteai.ca/estimating-software/): Quoting software for Canadian contractors: itemized quotes from a description, voice memo or photos, provincial GST/HST, PST or QST, and online acceptance.
- [Invoicing software for Canadian contractors](https://quoteai.ca/invoicing-software/): Deposit, progress and final invoices that follow your contract, with GST/HST and QST shown, e-Transfer or card payment, and reminders at 3, 7 and 14 days.
- [A contractor CRM that follows up for you](https://quoteai.ca/contractor-crm/): A CRM for contractors in Canada: leads from your website and WhatsApp, automatic quote follow-ups, review requests and a full history per client, within CASL.
- [Job costing software for contractors](https://quoteai.ca/job-costing-software/): Job costing for Canadian contractors: a budget per job from the signed contract, scanned receipts, crew hours as labour cost, budget vs actual, margin alerts.
- [Contracts and e-signature for Canadian contractors](https://quoteai.ca/contracts-e-signature/): Turn an accepted quote into a provincial contract, send it for e-signature with an email code, and keep the signed PDF, audit certificate and change orders.

## Free calculators

Free, no sign-up, in English and French: [all calculators](https://quoteai.ca/tools/).

- [GST, HST, PST and QST calculator for contractors](https://quoteai.ca/tools/sales-tax-calculator/): Add or remove GST, HST, PST and QST for any province, each tax on its own line.
- [Construction holdback calculator](https://quoteai.ca/tools/holdback-calculator/): The 10 % holdback on a progress bill, what is payable now, and the tax when it is released.
- [Markup vs margin calculator](https://quoteai.ca/tools/markup-margin-calculator/): Cost to price with a markup or a target margin, and why 25 % markup is only 20 % margin.
- [What should I charge per hour](https://quoteai.ca/tools/labour-rate-calculator/): The hourly rate that covers your pay, your overhead and a profit, from the hours you can really bill.

## Provinces

- [British Columbia](https://quoteai.ca/provinces/british-columbia/): sales tax on quotes and invoices shown as GST 5 % + PST 7 %.
- [Ontario](https://quoteai.ca/provinces/ontario/): sales tax on quotes and invoices shown as HST 13 %.
- [Quebec](https://quoteai.ca/provinces/quebec/): sales tax on quotes and invoices shown as GST 5 % + QST 9.975 %.

## Help centre

- [Set up your business in 10 minutes](https://quoteai.ca/help/getting-started/): Create your account, fill in the business profile that appears on every quote, contract and invoice, and pick a plan.
- [Create a quote from a description, a voice memo or photos](https://quoteai.ca/help/create-a-quote/): Describe the job in plain language and get an itemized, taxed quote in about 30 seconds. Then edit it, offer Good/Better/Best options and pick a PDF template.
- [Send a quote and get it accepted online](https://quoteai.ca/help/send-a-quote-and-get-it-accepted/): Email the quote or share its link. The customer reviews and accepts on a secure page; automatic follow-ups nudge them on days 2, 5 and 10 until they answer.
- [Contracts and e-signature](https://quoteai.ca/help/contracts-and-e-signature/): An accepted quote becomes a contract on your province's template. The customer signs online with an email code; you both get the signed PDF and audit certificate.
- [Jobs: setup review, milestones and change orders](https://quoteai.ca/help/jobs-milestones-and-change-orders/): Each signed contract becomes a job with AI-proposed milestones, schedule and budget. Confirm in one click and handle extras with change orders the customer signs.
- [Invoices, e-Transfer and card payments](https://quoteai.ca/help/invoices-and-getting-paid/): Deposit, progress and final invoices follow the contract's payment schedule. Customers pay by Interac e-Transfer or card, with reminders 3, 7 and 14 days overdue.
- [Track costs, scan receipts and log time](https://quoteai.ca/help/costs-receipts-and-time/): Photograph a receipt and the AI files it to the job. Workers clock in and out from a personal link, no app or login, and the job's margin updates in real time.
- [Invite your team and set roles](https://quoteai.ca/help/team-accounts-and-roles/): Give office staff, foremen or your accountant their own login with a role that limits what they can see and do. Pro includes 2 seats, Business 5 and Elite 10.
- [Leads, follow-ups and review requests](https://quoteai.ca/help/leads-and-follow-ups/): Quote requests from your website widget, WhatsApp, Meta Lead Ads or Google Local Services Ads land in Leads. Follow up within Canada's anti-spam rules.
- [Integrations and importing your old quotes](https://quoteai.ca/help/integrations-and-imports/): Send from Gmail, sync Google Calendar or Outlook, post paid invoices to QuickBooks or Wave, take cards via Stripe, and import past quotes from spreadsheets or PDFs.
- [Delete your account and data](https://quoteai.ca/help/delete-your-account/): How to delete your QuoteAI account from the app or the website, what is erased, what the law makes us keep, and how to change your mind within 7 days.

- [How to Scale a Contracting Business in Canada: From Solo to a Crew](https://quoteai.ca/blog/how-to-scale-a-contracting-business-canada/): Growing a Canadian trade business from solo to crews: first hire, subs vs employees, systems, incorporation, GST/HST, licensing and winter planning.
- [How to Track Job Costs as a Contractor (and Find Out Which Jobs Actually Make Money)](https://quoteai.ca/blog/how-to-track-job-costs-contractors/): Cost codes, daily labour capture, committed costs, WIP and over or under billing, with a bathroom job-cost sheet comparing estimate, actual and variance.
- [Job Site Management for Small Contractors: A Simple System That Works](https://quoteai.ca/blog/construction-project-management-small-contractors/): Run small renovations on schedule: trade sequencing, inspections as milestones, lead times, daily logs, Ontario safety notices and closeout, with an example.
- [Contractor Cash Flow: How to Stop Running Out of Money Between Jobs](https://quoteai.ca/blog/contractor-cash-flow-management-canada/): Why profitable contractors run short: GST/HST and payroll remittance dates, holdbacks, supplier terms and slow seasons, plus an eight-week cash forecast.
- [How to Quote a Painting Job: Measuring, Prep, Products and a Sample Quote](https://quoteai.ca/blog/how-to-quote-a-painting-job/): Price interior and exterior painting by measured area, prep, coats and your own production rates, with lead paint, VOC, fall protection and holdback rules.
- [How to Quote a Roofing Job in Canada: Squares, Decking, Eave Protection and Fall Protection](https://quoteai.ca/blog/how-to-quote-a-roofing-job/): Price a reroof from squares, pitch and waste, with a per-sheet decking rate, code eave protection, permits and fall protection, plus an Ontario sample quote.
- [How to Quote an Electrical Job in Canada: Service Calls, Rewires and Panel Upgrades](https://quoteai.ca/blog/how-to-quote-an-electrical-job/): How Canadian electricians price service calls, rewires and 200A panel upgrades: licensing, ESA and Technical Safety BC permits, cost drivers and a sample quote.
- [How to Quote a Plumbing Job in Canada: Service Calls, Renovations and Gas Work](https://quoteai.ca/blog/how-to-quote-a-plumbing-job/): Trip charges, flat-rate vs time and materials, client-supplied fixtures, permits and gas licensing, with a sample Ontario bathroom rough-in quote.
- [Quote vs Estimate vs Invoice: What Each Means for Canadian Contractors](https://quoteai.ca/blog/quote-vs-estimate-vs-invoice-difference/): How estimates, quotes and invoices differ in Canada: Ontario's 10% estimate rule, when a quote becomes a contract, and the CRA and QST invoice requirements.
- [How to Quote a Landscaping Job: Hardscape, Softscape and Seasonal Contracts](https://quoteai.ca/blog/how-to-quote-a-landscaping-job/): Measure in supplier units, book locates, handle grading, tree bylaws and plant warranties, with a sample Ontario sod, patio and garden bed quote.
- [How to Quote an HVAC Job in Canada: Sizing, Licensing and Line Items](https://quoteai.ca/blog/how-to-quote-an-hvac-job/): Quote heat pump and furnace jobs that hold up: CSA F280 sizing, separate equipment and labour lines, refrigerant and gas licensing, permits and rebate notes.
- [How to Quote a Tiling Job: Substrate, Waterproofing, Waste and a Sample Quote](https://quoteai.ca/blog/how-to-quote-a-tiling-job/): Quote tile floors, showers and backsplashes: waste by layout, underlay and flatness, shower membranes, heated floor inspections and client-supplied tile terms.
- [How to Raise Your Prices as a Contractor Without Losing Clients](https://quoteai.ca/blog/how-to-raise-your-prices-contractors-without-losing-clients/): When to raise contractor rates, how to read StatCan price data, how to tell repeat and commercial clients, and how to handle open quotes and long jobs.
- [Hiring Your First Employee as a Contractor in Canada: Payroll, Standards and Safety](https://quoteai.ca/blog/how-to-hire-your-first-employee-contractor-canada/): Payroll account, TD1s, 2026 CPP and EI, WSIB registration, Ontario construction ESA rules, working at heights and the ROE, with a sample first pay calculation.

## En français

quoteai est un logiciel de soumissions et de gestion de chantiers pour les entrepreneurs et gens de métier au Canada. Décrivez le travail en quelques mots et obtenez en 30 secondes une soumission professionnelle avec les bonnes taxes (TPS, TVH, TVP, TVQ) pour la province du client, puis le contrat, la signature, l'acompte, la facture et le paiement. Essai gratuit de 7 jours, sans carte de crédit.

- [Accueil](https://quoteai.ca/fr/)
- [Tarifs](https://quoteai.ca/fr/tarifs/)
- [Projet pilote](https://quoteai.ca/fr/pilote/)

Fonctionnalités :
- [Logiciel de soumission pour entrepreneurs du Québec](https://quoteai.ca/fr/logiciel-soumission/): Logiciel de soumission pour entrepreneurs du Québec : soumission détaillée à partir d’une description ou de photos, TPS et TVQ séparées, acceptation en ligne.
- [Logiciel de facturation pour entrepreneurs au Québec](https://quoteai.ca/fr/logiciel-facturation/): Factures de dépôt, d'étape et finale tirées du contrat, TPS, TVQ et licence RBQ affichées, Virement Interac ou carte, rappels à 3, 7 et 14 jours de retard.
- [Un CRM d'entrepreneur qui relance à votre place](https://quoteai.ca/fr/crm-entrepreneur/): CRM pour entrepreneur en construction : prospects du site Web et de WhatsApp, relances de soumission automatiques, demandes d'avis et historique client. LCAP.
- [Le coût de revient de chaque chantier](https://quoteai.ca/fr/logiciel-cout-de-revient/): Suivi des coûts de chantier pour entrepreneurs : budget tiré du contrat signé, reçus numérisés, heures de l'équipe, budget vs réel et alertes de dépassement.
- [Contrats et signature électronique pour les entrepreneurs du Québec](https://quoteai.ca/fr/contrats-signature-electronique/): Votre soumission acceptée devient un contrat sur le modèle de votre province, signé en ligne avec un code par courriel. Vos avenants signés suivent.

Calculateurs gratuits ([tous](https://quoteai.ca/fr/outils/)) :
